title: Parts availability and parts department contact
summary: This topic mainly contains parts-availability and parts-department references, but most examples do not provide enough sentiment evidence and one example appears unrelated to vehicle parts.

positive.summary: One positive review says the dealer's parts department was the best source for information on available run-flat options.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention waiting for parts, lack of availability, contact with the parts department, and a few unclear or unrelated difficulty references without enough context to label sentiment confidently.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are labeled undetermined, so the available evidence for clear sentiment is limited.
